notes: Cargo can choose an existing dependency, workspace member, or latest registry release.
This is ergonomic selection behavior, not recommendation authority.
Version selection without an explicit version can be influenced by MSRV.
Task-fit claims still require human review against runtime and lock-in constraints.

inference_notes: Easy discoverability lowers onboarding cost but does not settle role coverage or interop fit.
unresolved_questions: Does the candidate force one async runtime too early?
Does the candidate hide required companion crates behind feature flags or examples?
